documentation.content: Runbook row: Media reconciliation dry-run findings (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: a manager reviews a --list-eligible dry run and follows DEPLOY.md section 8's approval-gated manual deletion; --delete is never scheduled (board c414). Log-based metric media_reconcile_eligible_runs (infra/monitoring/metrics/media-reconcile-eligible-runs.json) crossing zero occurrences in a 5-minute window - a scheduled dry run found at least one eligible object. This is expected, review-worthy output, not itself a failure; c410's job-agnostic failure policy already covers a failed chirp-media-reconcile execution, so this alert adds no failure coverage. Risk: the jsonPayload.eligible>0 numeric comparison in the referenced log filter is not yet proven by a live create - chirps-17 creates this policy and validates the time series against a real scheduled execution before relying on it; no notification delivery is claimed by this change. Initial, review after 7 days.
